unavailable.name: GuruFocus “EPS without NRI” for past years
unavailable.wanted: Each past year's EPS excluding one-off items, as GuruFocus calculates it
unavailable.reason: It is GuruFocus's own calculation and appears only on its pages, which sit behind Cloudflare bot protection (HTTP 403 to any scheduled job).
unavailable.instead: Reported GAAP diluted EPS for each year (Yahoo), plus the latest fiscal year on the analysts' adjusted basis for exchange-listed tickers (Nasdaq). GAAP figures include one-off items, so they can sit well below the adjusted ones.
unavailable.option: GuruFocus's paid Data API returns EPS without NRI in one request per ticker; or type figures into overrides.csv.

unavailable.name: EPS estimates for every ticker, five years out
unavailable.wanted: Consensus EPS for 2026-2030 from GuruFocus, MarketWatch or Yahoo
unavailable.reason: Those estimate pages refuse scheduled jobs (Cloudflare, DataDome, and a Yahoo login token that scripts are not given), and no open feed carries estimates for OTC-traded ADRs.
unavailable.instead: Nasdaq's consensus for the next 3-4 fiscal years, exchange-listed tickers only. For OTC tickers: next year's EPS implied by Yahoo's forward P/E, where Yahoo has one. The fifth year is usually blank.
unavailable.option: A licensed estimates feed (GuruFocus, FactSet, LSEG or a market-data API vendor), or hand entry.

unavailable.name: GuruFocus Altman Z-Score and Piotroski F-Score
unavailable.wanted: The two scores exactly as GuruFocus publishes them
unavailable.reason: Same GuruFocus pages, same bot protection.
unavailable.instead: Both are calculated here from Yahoo's statements and usually land close to GuruFocus. Z is blank for banks, insurers and similar companies (the score needs working capital and EBIT, which they do not report); F is blank where any of its nine tests cannot be calculated.
unavailable.option: GuruFocus's paid Data API (same request as EPS without NRI).

unavailable.name: Yahoo “levered free cash flow” and Yahoo's own EBITDA
unavailable.wanted: The two key-statistics figures as Yahoo displays them
unavailable.reason: They are served only to signed-in browser sessions; Yahoo refuses the session token to scripts (HTTP 429). Yahoo has no public data service.
unavailable.instead: Free cash flow (operating cash flow minus capital spending) and EBITDA excluding unusual items, from Yahoo's statement feed. Same filings, slightly different definitions - expect differences of a few percent.
unavailable.option: None automated. Hand entry for the names that matter.

unavailable.name: Country from Yahoo's company profile
unavailable.instead: The workbook's own Country label; Nasdaq's listing record where the workbook is blank.
unavailable.option: Fill in the workbook's Country column - it always wins.

unavailable.name: Complete dividend history for some ADRs
unavailable.wanted: Dividend yield and 5-year dividend growth for every ticker
unavailable.reason: Yahoo's per-share dividend history stops in 2025 for many ADRs, mostly Japanese ones; the fuller figures are on the signed-in pages above.
unavailable.instead: Yield from the cash-flow statement (dividends paid divided by market value). Growth is measured up to the last dividend on record, or left blank where the history is too patchy.
unavailable.option: Hand entry, or a licensed dividend feed.
